description: Machine-readable environment manifest for the Maestro Template fake-first SaaS starter.

variables.name: APP_NAME
variables.rotation: Review on client handoff and release promotion.
variables.notes: Human-readable app name used in generated packets and UI copy.

variables.name: APP_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
variables.rotation: Review whenever the public domain changes.
variables.notes: Canonical public app URL for generated links and handoff docs.

variables.name: APP_ENV
variables.rotation: Review on environment creation.
variables.notes: Deployment posture label.

variables.name: APP_PROVIDER_MODE
variables.rotation: Review before enabling live provider calls.
variables.notes: Provider posture default; fake mode must not require live credentials.

variables.name: VITE_MAESTRO_AUTH_MODE
variables.rotation: Review on every environment creation and promotion.
variables.notes: Selects fixture or WorkOS web auth. Fixture is forbidden when APP_ENV is production.

variables.name: TEMPLATE_RUNTIME_MODE
variables.rotation: Review with runtime config changes.
variables.notes: Effect runtime mode. Defaults to fake when omitted.

variables.name: TEMPLATE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
variables.rotation: Review whenever public routes or domains change.
variables.notes: Public URL consumed by runtime services. Defaults locally when omitted.

variables.name: CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT
variables.rotation: Regenerate when the Convex deployment changes.
variables.notes: Convex deployment selector for local and hosted environments.

variables.name: VITE_CONVEX_URL
variables.rotation: Regenerate when the Convex deployment URL changes.
variables.notes: Browser-visible Convex URL baked into the static app. Leave blank in fake local web mode so Confect-backed UI renders skipped/fake-safe states.

variables.name: CONVEX_SITE_URL
variables.rotation: Review when the site URL changes.
variables.notes: Convex HTTP/site URL for callbacks and docs.

variables.name: CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY
variables.rotation: Rotate after deploy-admin changes and before production cutover.
variables.notes: Deployment secret required by project.config.json.

variables.name: TEMPLATE_CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY
variables.rotation: Rotate with CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY or when cluster secret ownership changes.
variables.notes: Namespaced CI secret used by template Woodpecker deployment scripts.

variables.name: TEMPLATE_STAGING_CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT
variables.rotation: Update only when the isolated staging deployment changes.
variables.notes: Externally bound staging Convex deployment coordinate.

variables.name: TEMPLATE_STAGING_CONVEX_URL
variables.rotation: Update only when the isolated staging deployment changes.
variables.notes: Externally bound staging Convex origin; must differ from production.

variables.name: TEMPLATE_STAGING_HOSTED_URL
variables.rotation: Update when the staging hosted origin changes.
variables.notes: Exact staging URL used by post-deploy hosted canaries.

variables.name: TEMPLATE_PRODUCTION_CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT
variables.rotation: Update only when the isolated production deployment changes.
variables.notes: Externally bound production Convex deployment coordinate.

variables.name: TEMPLATE_PRODUCTION_CONVEX_URL
variables.rotation: Update only when the isolated production deployment changes.
variables.notes: Externally bound production Convex origin; must differ from staging.

variables.name: TEMPLATE_PRODUCTION_HOSTED_URL
variables.rotation: Update when the production hosted origin changes.
variables.notes: Exact production URL used by post-deploy hosted canaries.

variables.name: TEMPLATE_STAGING_CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY
variables.rotation: Rotate after staging deploy-admin changes.
variables.notes: Staging-only Convex deploy credential.

variables.name: TEMPLATE_PRODUCTION_CONVEX_DEPLOY_KEY
variables.rotation: Rotate after production deploy-admin changes.
variables.notes: Production-only Convex deploy credential.

variables.name: TEMPLATE_STAGING_CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
variables.rotation: Rotate after staging deploy-admin changes.
variables.notes: Staging Pages-project-scoped Cloudflare token.

variables.name: TEMPLATE_STAGING_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
variables.rotation: Review when staging Cloudflare account ownership changes.
variables.notes: Staging Cloudflare account binding.

variables.name: TEMPLATE_PRODUCTION_CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
variables.rotation: Rotate after production deploy-admin changes.
variables.notes: Production Pages-project-scoped Cloudflare token.

variables.name: TEMPLATE_PRODUCTION_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
variables.rotation: Review when production Cloudflare account ownership changes.
variables.notes: Production Cloudflare account binding.

variables.name: WORKOS_CLIENT_ID
variables.rotation: Review when AuthKit application changes.
variables.notes: AuthKit client/application identifier.

variables.name: WORKOS_ORGANIZATION_ID
variables.rotation: Review when org provisioning changes.
variables.notes: Default organization identifier for fake and discovery modes.

variables.name: WORKOS_REDIRECT_URI
variables.rotation: Review whenever app domains change.
variables.notes: Auth redirect URI; must match WorkOS dashboard settings.

variables.name: WORKOS_LOGOUT_URI
variables.rotation: Review whenever app domains change.
variables.notes: Post-logout destination.

variables.name: WORKOS_COOKIE_PASSWORD
variables.rotation: Rotate before production, after team changes, and after suspected leaks.
variables.notes: Server-only cookie encryption password.

variables.name: WORKOS_API_KEY
variables.rotation: Rotate before production, after access changes, and after suspected leaks.
variables.notes: Server-only WorkOS API credential.

variables.name: POSTHOG_PROJECT_TOKEN
variables.rotation: Rotate when project ownership changes and review event schema each release.
variables.notes: PostHog project token used by the Convex component and readiness checks.

variables.name: POSTHOG_HOST
variables.rotation: Review when analytics host or region changes.
variables.notes: Optional PostHog host.

variables.name: DODO_API_KEY
variables.rotation: Rotate before launch, after billing admin changes, and after incidents.
variables.notes: Payment provider API key; fake values cannot charge.

variables.name: DODO_WEBHOOK_SECRET
variables.rotation: Rotate before launch, after billing admin changes, and after webhook incidents.
variables.notes: Webhook verifier secret.

variables.name: DODO_ENVIRONMENT
variables.rotation: Review before enabling paid flows.
variables.notes: Billing environment selector.

variables.name: DODO_BUILD_PACK_PRODUCT_ID
variables.rotation: Review whenever the one-time Build Pack product changes.
variables.notes: Server-owned Dodo product id for the Complete Build Pack checkout.

variables.name: DODO_BUILD_PACK_EXPECTED_AMOUNT_CENTS
variables.rotation: Change only with a matching Dodo product and canary record.
variables.notes: Fail-closed expected minor-unit amount for verified Build Pack webhooks; set to 100 only for the approved live canary.

variables.name: DODO_BUILD_PACK_EXPECTED_CURRENCY
variables.rotation: Change only with a matching Dodo product and canary record.
variables.notes: Fail-closed ISO currency binding for verified Build Pack webhooks.

variables.name: DODO_BUILD_PACK_LAUNCH_CANARY
variables.rotation: Remove immediately after the approved $1 canary refund.
variables.notes: Explicit launch-canary marker; never enable for normal $29 production traffic.

variables.name: ADMAXXER_API_KEY
variables.rotation: Rotate after provider access changes or attribution incidents.
variables.notes: Server-only Admaxxer Payments API key; never sent to browser or logs.

variables.name: POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN
variables.rotation: Rotate on team turnover and after deliverability incidents.
variables.notes: Postmark server token used only by the live email adapter.

variables.name: EMAIL_TRANSACTIONAL_FROM
variables.rotation: Review when sender domain changes.
variables.notes: Verified sender used for transactional outbound messages.

variables.name: EMAIL_MARKETING_FROM
variables.rotation: Review with brand copy.
variables.notes: Verified sender used for consented broadcast messages.

variables.name: EMAIL_REPLY_TO
variables.rotation: Review with support routing.
variables.notes: Reply address for marketing broadcasts.

variables.name: EMAIL_UNSUBSCRIBE_SECRET
variables.rotation: Rotate only with an unsubscribe-token migration plan.
variables.notes: Signs opaque expiring unsubscribe tokens.

variables.name: POSTMARK_WEBHOOK_USERNAME
variables.rotation: Review when webhook endpoints change.
variables.notes: HTTP Basic Auth username for Postmark webhooks.

variables.name: POSTMARK_WEBHOOK_PASSWORD
variables.rotation: Rotate on team turnover or webhook authentication incidents.
variables.notes: HTTP Basic Auth password for Postmark webhooks.

variables.name: EMAIL_DISABLED
variables.rotation: Review before enabling external email delivery.
variables.notes: Kill switch for outbound email delivery.

variables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
variables.rotation: Rotate before launch and after provider access changes.
variables.notes: OpenRouter-compatible model provider API key.

variables.name: OPENROUTER_BASE_URL
variables.rotation: Review when changing model provider gateway.
variables.notes: Provider-compatible API base URL.

variables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
variables.rotation: Rotate on CI admin changes and after log exposure.
variables.notes: Optional fallback provider key for AI review gates.

variables.name: LLM_PROVIDER_MODE
variables.rotation: Review before enabling live model calls.
variables.notes: LLM provider posture selector.

variables.name: LLM_DISABLED
variables.rotation: Review before demos and production launches.
variables.notes: Global kill switch for model calls.

variables.name: LLM_DAILY_SPEND_LIMIT_CENTS
variables.rotation: Review each release and before live enablement.
variables.notes: Daily spend guardrail.

variables.name: LLM_DEFAULT_MODEL
variables.rotation: Review model allowlist each release.
variables.notes: Default model identifier.

variables.name: LLM_FREE_MODEL
variables.rotation: Review cost and structured-output quality each release.
variables.notes: Low-cost model used only for bounded free evaluations.

variables.name: LLM_PREMIUM_MODEL
variables.rotation: Review output quality and model allowlist each release.
variables.notes: Higher-quality model used by paid checkpointed Build Pack stages.

variables.name: LLM_FREE_DAILY_SPEND_LIMIT_CENTS
variables.rotation: Review daily while tuning acquisition traffic.
variables.notes: Independent daily ceiling for free-funnel model calls.

variables.name: LLM_PREMIUM_DAILY_SPEND_LIMIT_CENTS
variables.rotation: Review against paid pack revenue each release.
variables.notes: Independent daily ceiling for entitlement-gated premium generation.

variables.name: STORAGE_PROVIDER
variables.rotation: Review before promoting uploaded file support.
variables.notes: Storage provider posture selector.

variables.name: STORAGE_BUCKET
variables.rotation: Review bucket ownership and policy quarterly.
variables.notes: Object storage bucket or namespace.

variables.name: STORAGE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL
variables.rotation: Review when CDN or bucket routing changes.
variables.notes: Base URL used by the storage signing seam.

variables.name: STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID
variables.rotation: Rotate on team turnover and after storage incidents.
variables.notes: Storage access key id for live providers.

variables.name: STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
variables.rotation: Rotate on team turnover and after storage incidents.
variables.notes: Storage secret access key for live providers.

variables.name: SEARCH_PROVIDER
variables.rotation: Review before enabling search or RAG-backed retrieval.
variables.notes: Search provider posture selector.

variables.name: SEARCH_API_KEY
variables.rotation: Rotate before live enablement and after provider access changes.
variables.notes: Optional search provider API key.

variables.name: SEARCH_INDEX_PREFIX
variables.rotation: Review after schema or redaction changes.
variables.notes: Index namespace prefix.

variables.name: CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
variables.rotation: Review on deploy-admin changes.
variables.notes: Cloudflare account identifier required by deploy config.

variables.name: CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
variables.rotation: Rotate on deploy-admin changes and before production cutover.
variables.notes: Cloudflare API token required by deploy config.

variables.name: TEMPLATE_CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN
variables.rotation: Rotate with CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN or when cluster secret ownership changes.
variables.notes: Namespaced CI secret used by template Woodpecker deployment scripts.

variables.name: TEMPLATE_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID
variables.rotation: Rotate with Cloudflare deploy credentials.
variables.notes: Namespaced CI account ID used by template Woodpecker deployment scripts.

variables.name: CLOUDFLARE_PAGES_PROJECT
variables.rotation: Review when Pages project changes.
variables.notes: Cloudflare Pages project name.

variables.name: CLOUDFLARE_PAGES_BRANCH
variables.rotation: Review when branch promotion policy changes.
variables.notes: Cloudflare Pages branch selector.

variables.name: TEMPLATE_HOSTED_URL
variables.rotation: Review when hosted smoke target changes.
variables.notes: Hosted URL used by smoke and readiness checks.

variables.name: WOODPECKER_SERVER
variables.rotation: Review when CI organization changes.
variables.notes: Woodpecker server URL.

variables.name: WOODPECKER_REPOSITORY
variables.rotation: Review when CI pipeline changes.
variables.notes: Woodpecker repository slug.

variables.name: WOODPECKER_API_TOKEN
variables.rotation: Rotate after CI admin changes and log exposure.
variables.notes: Woodpecker API token for repository and deployment management.

variables.name: WOODPECKER_TOKEN
variables.rotation: Rotate after CI admin changes and log exposure.
variables.notes: Woodpecker CLI token, sourced from WOODPECKER_API_TOKEN for operator commands.

variables.name: CI
variables.rotation: Managed by Woodpecker.
variables.notes: Standard CI runtime marker used by CI scripts.

variables.name: CI_COMMIT_SHA
variables.rotation: Managed by Woodpecker.
variables.notes: Commit SHA for deploy and promotion scripts.

variables.name: PROMOTION_AUTHORITY_ENDPOINT
variables.rotation: Review only when the independent authority control plane moves.
variables.notes: Already-live independent deployment-authority HTTPS origin. It must be a base URL without credentials, path, query, or fragment and must not be the target Convex origin.

variables.name: PROMOTION_AUTHORITY_MODE
variables.rotation: Immutable for the independent authority deployment; review any mode change as a control-plane migration.
variables.notes: Authority-runtime discriminator. The only accepted value is exactly authority; application staging and production deployments must not set it.

variables.name: PROMOTION_AUTHORITY_PRIVATE_KEY_PKCS8_BASE64URL
variables.rotation: Rotate through the independent authority key ceremony and republish the reviewed public trust material.
variables.notes: Ed25519 PKCS#8 signing key for the authority runtime only. Never provision, expose, query, or serialize this value in Woodpecker or application deploy receipts.

variables.name: TRUSTED_DEPLOY_ROOT_SHA256
variables.rotation: Update through an external reviewed trust-root ceremony only.
variables.notes: Externally pinned sha256 root over the deploy verifier, policy, and public verification key. The authority signing key never enters this repository or Woodpecker.

variables.name: TRUSTED_CI_SELF_PROTECTION_COMMIT
variables.rotation: Advance only after the reviewed self-protection successor commit is immutable.
variables.notes: Exact externally pinned commit whose setup, deploy-authority verifier, and secretless self-protection script run instead of PR-head bootstrap scripts.

variables.name: TRUSTED_ROLLBACK_SEED_COMMIT
variables.rotation: Set once to the first reviewed guarded successor; advance only through a separately reviewed freeze ceremony.
variables.notes: Exact immutable rollback ancestry floor. Pre-seed targets are never eligible for automated rollback.

variables.name: STAGING_PREVIOUS_CONVEX_COMMIT_SHA
variables.rotation: Advance after each accepted staging deployment.
variables.notes: Reviewed prior staging commit recorded in the next rollback receipt.

variables.name: STAGING_PREVIOUS_CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT
variables.rotation: Advance when the staging Convex deployment coordinate changes.
variables.notes: Reviewed prior staging Convex deployment coordinate.

variables.name: STAGING_PREVIOUS_CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOYMENT_VERSION
variables.rotation: Advance after each accepted staging Pages deployment.
variables.notes: Reviewed prior staging Cloudflare deployment version.

variables.name: PRODUCTION_PREVIOUS_CONVEX_COMMIT_SHA
variables.rotation: Advance after each accepted production deployment.
variables.notes: Reviewed prior production commit recorded in the next rollback receipt.

variables.name: PRODUCTION_PREVIOUS_CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT
variables.rotation: Advance when the production Convex deployment coordinate changes.
variables.notes: Reviewed prior production Convex deployment coordinate.

variables.name: PRODUCTION_PREVIOUS_CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOYMENT_VERSION
variables.rotation: Advance after each accepted production Pages deployment.
variables.notes: Reviewed prior production Cloudflare deployment version.

variables.name: RUN_ROLLBACK
variables.rotation: Set only for a reviewed rollback build and clear afterward.
variables.notes: Selects the guarded production rollback path.

variables.name: ROLLBACK_RECEIPT_PATH
variables.rotation: Bind to the reviewed receipt artifact for each rollback.
variables.notes: Local path of the downloaded guarded deployment receipt.

variables.name: ROLLBACK_RECEIPT_BUILD_ID
variables.rotation: Bind to the immutable source build recorded by each reviewed rollback receipt.
variables.notes: Public Woodpecker pipeline coordinate used to reject a receipt from any other deployment build.

variables.name: ROLLBACK_CLOUDFLARE_DEPLOYMENT_VERSION
variables.rotation: Bind to the exact reviewed prior version for each rollback.
variables.notes: Must match the prior Cloudflare version and checked-out rollback commit.

variables.name: CI_COMMIT_PULL_REQUEST
variables.rotation: Managed by Woodpecker.
variables.notes: Pull request number exposed by Woodpecker.

variables.name: CI_COMMIT_TARGET_BRANCH
variables.rotation: Managed by Woodpecker.
variables.notes: Base branch for trusted AI gate worktree setup.

variables.name: CI_PIPELINE_DEPLOY_TARGET
variables.rotation: Managed by Woodpecker.
variables.notes: Deployment target selector; must be staging or production.

variables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
variables.rotation: Rotate after GitHub app or CI admin changes.
variables.notes: Optional token for posting AI gate comments.

variables.name: RUN_MUTATION
variables.rotation: Review with mutation testing policy.
variables.notes: Local override for mutation gate execution.

variables.name: TASTE_PROVIDER
variables.rotation: Review when AI gate provider changes.
variables.notes: AI taste-review provider selector.

variables.name: TASTE_OPENROUTER_MODEL
variables.rotation: Review when AI gate model changes.
variables.notes: AI taste-review model selector.

variables.name: TASTE_REVIEW_WORKTREE
variables.rotation: Managed by CI scripts.
variables.notes: Trusted worktree path for taste gate.

variables.name: CONTRACT_REVIEW_REQUIRE_AUTH
variables.rotation: Managed by CI scripts.
variables.notes: Fail-closed marker for contract-review auth.

variables.name: CONTRACT_BASE
variables.rotation: Managed by CI scripts.
variables.notes: Base ref for contract review.

variables.name: CONTRACT_REVIEW_WORKTREE
variables.rotation: Managed by CI scripts.
variables.notes: Trusted worktree path for contract review.
